env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group-child send of a value whose type is an anonymous struct with
# unexported fields from another package keeps inference: spelling the
# element type in the caller's package would name a different type,
# because unexported field identities include their declaring package.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok 3$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^ok 3$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/groupsendanon

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "context"

func Channel() chan struct{ x int } {
	return make(chan struct{ x int }, 1)
}

func Value() struct{ x int } {
	return struct{ x int }{x: 3}
}

func Take(ctx context.Context, ch chan struct{ x int }) int {
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		return v.x
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return -1
	}
}
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"example.com/groupsendanon/lib"
	"fmt"
)

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch := lib.Channel()
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			ch <- lib.Value()
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", lib.Take(ctx, ch))
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
	}
}
